description: Lists what photos, videos, PDFs and RAW files reveal without changing them: GPS location, camera, serial numbers, author, dates, C2PA Content Credentials, AI generator tags and AI prompts. Use it to check a file before sharing or to confirm a clean copy is clean.

recursive.description: Include sub-folders when a folder is given.
